name: SubDL Scribe
description: SubDL Scribe brings SubDL.com to Jellyfin: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Download is on by default; upload is off — enable at your choice. Requires a SubDL login and API Key plus a TMDb API Key.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog:
v12.1.12.175: A pending deferred fire now decides the worker's word and colour for every row
    that does not claim something stronger, not only for a green one. The previous version
    overrode green alone, so the download sat on a yellow "cancel" while its fire for 04:37 was
    waiting - and "cancel" is the wrong word for a direction that is scheduled to resume. Both
    "ok" and "cancelled" claim that nothing is owed, and a pending fire proves otherwise. Only
    "failed" (something is broken) and "run" (in progress) are left alone.
